summary: Dedicated preschool teacher with over a decade of experience fostering early childhood development through play-based and structured learning. Skilled in adapting instruction to diverse needs and building strong partnerships with guardians to support each child's growth.

experience.title: Lead Preschool Teacher
experience.employer: a growing mid-market early learning center
bullets: Design and implement daily lesson plans focused on color, shape, number, and letter recognition, raising kindergarten-readiness assessment scores by 22% over two years.
Establish and enforce clear behavioral rules and classroom routines, reducing daily disruptions and improving observed social cooperation among students.
Adapt teaching methods and materials for students with varying developmental needs and interests, including those requiring individualized learning strategies.
Organize and lead activities such as arts and crafts, music, storytelling, and supervised field trips that promote physical, mental, and social development.
Meet regularly with guardians to discuss progress, needs, and priorities, and to suggest home activities that reinforce learning and development.
Provide diverse materials and resources for exploration, imaginative play, and hands-on manipulation in both structured and free-choice learning centers.
Serve meals and snacks in accordance with nutritional guidelines, and attend to basic care needs including feeding, dressing, and diapering.

experience.title: Preschool Teacher
experience.employer: a mid-sized community child development center
bullets: Taught foundational skills in number and letter recognition, personal hygiene, and social interaction to classes of up to 18 students.
Maintained classroom order through consistent behavior expectations, positive reinforcement, and age-appropriate conflict resolution strategies.
Developed and sourced instructional materials tailored to mixed-age and mixed-ability groups, supporting active learning and critical thinking.
Led daily music, movement, and storytelling sessions that boosted student engagement and early literacy participation.
Conducted biannual guardian conferences to review developmental milestones and co-create learning goals.
Collaborated with co-teachers to monitor student progress and adjust instructional approaches accordingly.

experience.title: Assistant Preschool Teacher
experience.employer: a regional nonprofit early education program
bullets: Supported lead teachers in delivering lessons on color, shape, number, and letter recognition and personal hygiene routines.
Prepared and organized learning materials for arts, crafts, and imaginative play activities.
Supervised meal and snack times, ensuring adherence to nutritional guidelines and assisting with feeding and dressing as needed.
Observed and documented student behavior and development to inform instructional planning and guardian updates.
Helped maintain a safe, orderly classroom by reinforcing rules and procedures consistently.

experience.title: Preschool Teaching Aide
experience.employer: a local early childhood learning center
bullets: Assisted with daily classroom activities promoting physical, mental, and social development through games, crafts, and storytelling.
Provided one-on-one support to students needing extra help with basic skills and classroom routines.
Helped set up and rotate learning materials to keep exploration and play areas engaging and safe.
Attended to basic care needs including diapering, dressing, and mealtime assistance under teacher supervision.

education.degree: Associate of Applied Science in Early Childhood Education
